content.text: 'Unwell Winter Games' Season 1 Cast Guide: Where to Watch, Their Instagrams and More X Your Guide to ‘Unwell Winter Games’ Season 1: Full Cast List & Where to Watch Avery Thompson April 5, 2026, 6:00 pm Comments Jesse Grant / Getty Images for Leigh Steinberg / Monica Schipper / Getty Images / Dave Kotinsky / Getty Images for Base Beauty This excerpt appearscourtesy of our partner site We’re total suckers for reality dating shows, from Love Island to Love Is Blind, and yes, most recently, Love Overboard. But now? We’re ready for some full-on competition drama… especially when it involves some reality TV legends. Enter the Unwell Winter Games, hosted by Call Her Daddy’s Alex Cooper. This four-episode reality competition, which takes place in Park City, Utah, follows 16 of today’s most “polarizing” pop culture personalities — think House of Villains, but make it chic. And trust us, they really mean polarizing. These are the people we never thought we’d see in the spotlight again… and yet, here we are, intrigued. Continue ReadingOn Swooon for free!
